policy.delegation: implementation with independent security and evidence review

acceptance: Working integrations: Real invoices, contacts, allowed discounts, payment provider, human-transfer target connected, and disabled routes restored after successful integration tests
Dataset review: Representative batch review with business answer approvals, bilingual language/meaning verification, clean leak-free corpus generation and review receipts
Baseline measurement: Current Groq/Gemini system evaluated on unseen scenarios (development/test) measuring accuracy, intent f1, slots, action validity
Cloud training: Reviewed data smoke run + full fine-tuning with QLoRA, exact loss, weights save, reload and held-out evaluation verified
Voice testing: Hinglish/English recordings testing pronunciation, pauses, interruptions and missed words; phonetic mapping and pause controls
Controlled pilot: Authorized test calls, real provider receipts and monitoring pass before production
external_blockers: Remote GPU purchase requires external compute deployment
Live PSTN phone calls to external customers requires explicit client consent and scheduled pilot window
